displayTitle: Episode I: Watch Out, Jar Jar!
synopsis: Star Wars Episode I: Watch Out, Jar Jar! is a children's book written by Kerry Milliron and illustrated by Bob Eggleton. It features Jar Jar Binks' adventures during the events of Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace. The book is part of the Random House Star Wars Storybook series and includes twelve stickers. Jar Jar Binks is a clumsy Gungan. He is always getting into trouble. Lucky for him, a wise Jedi Master is ready to help him out of it!
title: Star Wars Episode I: Watch Out, Jar Jar!
